python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Create gradlew directly - minimal version for wrapper execution
gradlew = '''#!/bin/sh
# Gradle wrapper stub - downloads and runs gradle
GRADLE_VERSION="8.5"
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
WRAPPER_DIR="$DIR/gradle/wrapper"
if [ ! -f "$WRAPPER_DIR/gradle-wrapper.jar" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$WRAPPER_DIR"
    echo "Downloading Gradle wrapper..."
    curl -sL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v$GRADLE_VERSION/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" -o "$WRAPPER_DIR/gradle-wrapper.jar"
fi
CLASSPATH="$WRAPPER_DIR/gradle-wrapper.jar"
exec java -classpath "$CLASSPATH" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain "$@"
'''
sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/gradlew', 'w') as f:
    f.write(gradlew)
c.exec_command('chmod +x /tmp/gradlew && cp /tmp/gradlew /opt/areloria/client/android/gradlew')
# Also create missing wrapper jar
c.exec_command("""mkdir -p /opt/areloria/client/android/gradle/wrapper
curl -sL "https://github.com/nicowitt/nicowitt/raw/refs/heads/main/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" -o /opt/areloria/client/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar 2>/dev/null || echo 'will use gradle install'""")
print("Created!")
c.close()
EOF
